title: Knowledge candidate export envelope v1 (both outbound projections of one stored candidate, and the proof nothing was sent)
$comment: Emitter: src/design_lab/knowledge_review.py (KnowledgeReview.export_document), served by GET /api/projects/<id>/knowledge-candidates/<candidate_id>/export. This envelope is what `export_payload` and `to_v1_projection` were finally called by: producing the document is not delivering it, so `outbound.transport` is const NOT_CONNECTED and `sent_count` const 0 while `bytes` counts what was assembled, not what left the machine. The two projections are $ref'd, never restated: `export` is design-lab/assurance-knowledge-candidate-v2.schema.json#/$defs/export (self-validated by knowledge_feedback.export_payload before it returns) and `v1_projection` is candidate-knowledge.schema.json, whose v1 `source_id` is built by concatenating the ids the submitter stored. `provenance` echoes those stored ids as they are -- this route never fills a provenance field on a caller's behalf, and a blank is refused at write time, so both ids being non-empty text is the write contract's guarantee restated where a reader can check it. The literal `UNUSED` is the operator's explicit 「不用」 (owner ruling 2026-10-20) and is reported as state EXPLICITLY_UNUSED, not as an absent id. `freshness` compares only the candidate's recorded design_lab_sha against this checkout's HEAD: UNKNOWN means one of the two was unreadable, which is not a claim of同步.
